Classify the bearing state as healthy, outer_race_fault, or inner_race_fault from whole-record summaries. Each record describes a ball bearing in a controlled drive-system test rig. force is radial bearing force; phase_current_1 and phase_current_2 are two motor phase current signals; speed is shaft speed; temp_2_bearing_module is bearing-module temperature; torque is shaft torque; vibration_1 is bearing-housing acceleration. The source MAT physical-unit fields are empty: amplitude summaries retain the original recorded scale and are not claimed to be calibrated SI values. Population SD uses ddof0. RMS is the root mean square; absolute crest factor is maximum absolute amplitude divided by RMS; Pearson kurtosis is the centered fourth moment divided by the squared centered second moment (not excess kurtosis). Vibration relative powers partition the demeaned unwindowed one-sided periodogram into the listed fixed frequency bands, using the publisher nominal sampling frequency64000Hz. No per-record bearing identifiers, acquisition times or operating-condition labels are supplied.
Values follow the shared dictionary exactly. Treat each record independently; no demonstrations, class counts or reference labels are provided. Return only a JSON array in the input record order, with exactly the keys id and predicted for each record.
